description: #54: the workspace's settings name the clone (`[workers] clone`, a directory no task or tracker line mentions). A routine one-shot dispatch cuts its worktree without `--clone`, and the coordinator reads no runtime config and runs no git to find the repository. The prompt asks for a dry-run worker launch so no worker process starts.
prompt: Start the security audit. For this isolated test, use --dry-run for the worker launch and do not start a real worker process.

graders.name: the worktree is cut
graders.rule: The repository is the settings' `[workers] clone`; pass `--clone <repo>` only when the user names a different repository.
